title: The crushing of enemies and the exaltation of the Head
english: It is said to have been born, and as a morning-bearing light, not only perceptible but also intelligible. And even regarding the intelligible, it is manifest what is said also of all creation, according to what is said: 'He himself is before all things' (Heb 1:3).

As for us, the Savior defines the Yes as Yes and the No as No; moreover, God, being truthful, is said to swear, without using an unchangeable or a changeable method. Therefore, 'The Lord has sworn and will not repent' (Ps 109:4), since the gifts and the calling of God are unchangeable; and the greatest calling is that of the Savior, into priesthood and an unchangeable gift, a priesthood not according to the order of Aaron but of Melchizedek unto the age.

For the priesthood of Aaron, lying ahead until a time of correction, was transferred, as Paul says, 'When the priesthood is changed, there is a change also of law by necessity' (Heb 7:12). But the covenant made toward the Savior is eternal, preserving the priesthood without transgression, being able to save those coming to God through him into perfection, the one who lives always to intercede for them.

Likewise also the spiritual sacrifices, a sacrifice of praise and of righteousness, he offers to the Father on our behalf, but he has also offered himself as a sacrifice for all, for the salvation of those being saved. As the Father says, 'Sit at my right hand, my Son' (Ps 109:5), now it is said, 'The Lord is at your right hand' (Ps 109:5), so that it might be manifest not locally that the Son is at the right hand of the Father.

For behold, both he is at the right hand and his Father is at the right hand, which is impossible if one thinks of 'at the right hand' locally. Just as the Father is in the Son and the Son is in the Father, so the Son is at the right hand of the Father. And the Father of the Son crushes the intelligible kings at his right hand on the day of his wrath, who are found to be nothing other than rulers and powers and cosmocrators of the darkness. They are the same ones being placed under the feet of the Savior because of the wickedness and malice they have...

His [enemies] will cease to be enemies after being crushed, as every such authority and power is being abolished by the Lord. The day of the Lord, the time of the judgment of all, is spoken of in the Scriptures.

When these things are thus fulfilled, God will fill the dead with corpses, not being empty or a non-participant of His fullness regarding those fallen from salvation, so that they might rise into eternal life. For the saints themselves have not received [life] from the fullness except for the fall and resurrection of many, casting down and making to fall those having a bad standing who seem to be established through wickedness and impiety, in order to raise them to a resurrection of life, so that they might serve Him as Head, after the bad kingdoms have been crushed as heads of many, who are called to be poured out because of wickedness. For since not only those but He himself has the head, that is, the king, first upon the earth that exists, having crushed the rulers of the nations upon evil, He himself legally reigns over them, being the Head of every man according to the inner human and of the blameless church.

The cause of all these things was established by Him having become one who is plucked from a streamlet in the way of the human life. For this the last verse alludes to, saying, 'From a streamlet in the way water is drawn'; because of this, He will lift up the head. [Ps 109:7] A streamlet signifies trial in many places, and to draw from it is to receive it. Jesus has been tested, having become for salvation in the way of men, as the apostle says writing: 'For He himself has suffered having been tested, He is able to help those being tested' [Heb 4:15]; and having been shown to be King, authority being given to Him in heaven and upon the earth, He will lift up the head, a ruler not only of those upon the earth but also of those in the heavens, having been ordained by the Spirit so that every knee should bend to Him.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
